_note: Hand-curated. perHour = rough units per hour for a near-maxed player using a normal (non tick-perfect) method, rounded down. In task strings {n} is the count and {s} a plural 's'. xp = production skills are XP targets by any method; perHour is a comfortable XP rate, not the best one. fixed = one-off tasks with a time estimate instead of a rate (Farming, where growth timers rule out bulk counts). item = item whose icon represents the activity. consumes = tradeable item used up once per unit (used for the gp-at-stake line).
